panels.title: HTTP Response Time (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Full HTTP response time including serialization and network. Covers the complete request lifecycle from accept to response sent.

panels.title: Cache Entries & Memory
panels.description: Left axis: number of cache entries. Right axis: tracked memory bytes used by cache.

panels.title: Doc Cache Size
panels.description: Left axis: number of cached documents. Right axis: memory consumed by doc cache.

panels.title: Process RSS
panels.description: Process resident set size. Pod limit is 32 GB. Alert threshold at 28 GB.

panels.title: RSS vs Tracked Memory
panels.description: Stacked area showing tracked memory components vs total RSS. The 'other' slice represents jemalloc overhead, page cache, and untracked allocations.

panels.title: Memory Breakdown
panels.description: Proportional breakdown of tracked memory components.

panels.title: Lazy Load Duration (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Duration of lazy-loading filter fields from disk. The first query after a restart triggers lazy loading -- sortAt at 105M takes 22s. Monitor this to catch stall events.

panels.title: Flush Phase Timing
panels.description: Breakdown of flush cycle phases: apply mutations, cache maintenance, snapshot publish, time bucket refresh, and compaction.

panels.title: Sync V2 Lag
panels.description: Shows the gap between the sync cursor and the maximum available ID. Growing lag means the sync pipeline is falling behind.
